title: Taking Your Team to the Top: How to Build and Manage Great Teams like the Pros
description:
LEARN HOW TO SPOT TALENT, BUILD A GREAT TEAM, AND WIN IN BUSINESS!

Ted Sundquist was educated at the U.S. Air Force Academy. He played and coached football for the Academy, served as a flight commander in Germany, and went on to become General Manager of the Denver Broncos. In other words, Sundquist has spent his entire adult life building powerful, effective teams that get things done.

In Taking Your Team to the Top, Sundquist gives you the knowledge, skills, and motivation to replicate his remarkable success.

Whether you run a global corporation or small business, you'll learn how to accurately evaluate new hires from enormous talent pools, quickly implement them into your organization's existing team culture, and create a dedicated mission statement to maximize team success.

In this groundbreaking guide, Sundquist combines the sum total of his vast and diverse leadership experience with lessons and insights from some of today's top leadership experts, including:

DANA PERINO, White House Press Secretary for President George W. Bush
DR. TOM OSBORNE, Head Coach of the University of Nebraska football team and U.S. Congressman
DR. HARVEY SCHILLER, Commissioner of the SEC and Secretary General of the U.S. Olympic Committee
ED ROSKI, one of the Forbes 200 richest people in America
JEFF PASH, Executive VP and General Counsel of the NFL
CHAD HENNINGS, three-time Super Bowl Champion and defensive tackle for the Dallas Cowboys

You can have the best business strategy available. But without the best and brightest people collaborating in a healthy way to execute that strategy, it's only worth the paper it's printed on.

Taking Your Team to the Top offers the fundamentals you need to unlock individuals' abilities and talents while adding to team synergy to accomplish any business objective, in any business--large or small.

PRAISE FOR TAKING YOUR TEAM TO THE TOP:

"Ted Sundquist outlines in detail how to organize and lead a corporation to real success. He provides a plan to reach this success while always emphasizing the importance of personal involvement, compassion, and caring for your people (employees). I highly recommend Taking Your Team to the Top for all CEOs of every level." -- Lt. General Winfield W. Scott, Jr., United States Air Force

"Having had the opportunity to play under Ted's leadership on the Denver Broncos, I came to highly respect him not only as a person but for his managerial skills that lead us to two Super Bowl championships.... If you are seeking insight into how to best build, manage, and lead your team to success, this book is an absolute must-have." -- Jason Elam, All-Pro Placekicker, NFL 1993-2009

"In a world quick to measure short-term performance, we often get fleeting temporary results. I love how Ted challenges some of these norms and embraces a leadership style that is others-focused: built around compassion, chemistry and ultimately a long-term lasting impact. This book is a great read for the leader who is looking to leverage his or her position for real impact and influence on others." -- Jeff Nolde, Vice President, Values Based Wealth Management, Morgan Stanley

"Ted has drawn on his experience as an athlete, military officer, and NFL club executive to create a valuable and practical guide for anyone in a position of leadership, whether it be business or sports executive, a head coach or entrepreneur." -- Jack Mills, President, Ascent Sports

title: Manager’s Guide to Mobile Learning
description:

title: The Decency Code: The Leader's Path to Building Integrity and Trust
description:
The essential guide to creating an honest, ethical workplace culture in any industry

In The Manager’s Book of Decencies, Stephen Harrison showed how even the smallest gestures can produce big results and change the culture of an entire workforce. Now the author of that prescient bestseller has teamed up with Jim Lukaszewski, America’s Crisis Guru® to write the definitive guide to transforming or restoring your workplace into a showplace of honest, ethical behavior.

Accountability, civility, compassion, empathy, honesty, humility, and principle: these are the seven characteristics embodied by every truly decent leader. The best organizations develop and maintain a civil culture, valuing ethical behavior, honesty, and integrity as much, or even more, than profitability.

The Decency Code provides you with practical pathways to creating or restoring that type of culture. These strategies address the evolving workplace: flexible, fast-moving, delayered, virtual, unstable, out-of-balance, ambiguous, global, diverse, and ruthlessly competitive. Here are actionable tools and strategies to help you build your workplace on a new standard of honest, ethical behavior, along with informative case studies that examine the behavior of both ethical and unethical companies.

Today’s climate of corporate cultural disorder needs a new type of leader, men and women who replace confusion with order, opaqueness with clarity, complexity with simplicity, hopelessness with confidence, greed with selflessness, and suspicion with trust. The common-sense prescriptions offered in The Decency Code can help you become the type of leader you wish to be—and effect the change you wish to see. This book is required reading for ethically conscious managers everywhere.

Ahora el autor de ese bestseller precientífico se ha unido con Jim Lukaszewski, America’s Crisis Guru® para escribir la guía definitiva para transformar o restaurar su lugar de trabajo en un lugar de actuación honesta y ética.

Responsabilidad, civilidad, compasión, empatía, honestidad, humildad y principio: estas son las siete características encarnadas por cada líder verdaderamente decente. Las mejores organizaciones desarrollan y mantienen una cultura civil, valorando el comportamiento ético, la honestidad y la integridad tanto, o incluso más, que la rentabilidad.

El Código de Decencia le proporciona vías prácticas para crear o restaurar ese tipo de cultura. Estas estrategias abordan el lugar de trabajo en evolución: flexible, rápido, retrasado, virtual, inestable, fuera de balance, ambiguo, global, diverso y despiadadamente competitivo. Aquí están las herramientas y estrategias de acción para ayudarle a construir su lugar de trabajo sobre un nuevo estándar de conducta honesta y ética, junto con estudios de casos informativos que examinan el comportamiento de las empresas éticas y no éticas.

El clima actual de desorden cultural corporativo necesita un nuevo tipo de líder, hombres y mujeres que reemplazan la confusión con orden, opacidad con claridad, complejidad con sencillez, desesperanza con confianza, codicia con abnegación y sospecha con confianza. Las recetas de sentido común ofrecidas en el Código de Divisibilidad pueden ayudarte a convertirte en el tipo de líder que deseas ser y hacer efectivo el cambio que deseas ver. Este libro es requerido lectura para administradores éticamente conscientes en todas partes.

title: Alive and Well at the End of the Day, 2nd Edition
description:
Alive and Well at the End of the Day

Practical book showing professionals the “what to dos” and “how to dos” for effective safety leadership

The Second Edition of Alive and Well at the End of the Day provides industrial leaders in operations with practical solutions to the tough safety leadership challenges they must manage. The book describes in detail the nature of those challenges (what makes them that tough) and offers proven best practices to successfully deal with them.

The practices described in the book come from the author’s first-hand observation of leaders in operations who were successful in leading and managing safety performance. These best practices are defined and described in detail, allowing the reader to immediately and successfully put them into practice.

In addition to providing “what to do” and “how to do that” for effective safety leadership, the book also explains “how it works” and “why to do it that way.” By taking this approach, the book provides deeper insight and understanding in addition to effective practices.

The book’s contents are organized in a way that allows the reader the ability to match up chapters with specific challenges they are facing.

In Alive and Well at the End of the Day, readers can expect to find discussion on:

The practice of leadership, Moments of High Influence, Managing By Walking Around, and following all the rules, all the time
Recognizing hazards and managing risk, behavior, consequences, and attitude, the power of good questions, and making change happen
Managing accountability, safety meetings worth having, managing safety suggestions, creating the culture you want, and investing in training
Understanding what went wrong, measuring safety performance, managing safety dilemmas, leading from the middle, and common mistakes managers make

Leaders in industrial operations responsible for leading and managing safety performance, from CEOs to frontline leaders, can use Alive and Well at the End of the Day, in conjunction with the included study guide, to understand and implement a powerful process to improve the supervisor’s practice of safety leadership.

Reconocer los peligros y gestionar el riesgo, el comportamiento, las consecuencias y la actitud, el poder de las buenas preguntas y hacer que el cambio suceda

title: Lean Sigma--Rebuilding Capability in Healthcare
description:
Drive Lean Sigma Performance Improvement into Any Hospital or Healthcare Environment

“The Affordable Care Act (ACA) looks like it is around to stay. It will require hospitals and other healthcare organizations to become ruthlessly efficient to survive reimbursement rate reductions. Even if ACA fell, managed care organizations have caught on. They will leverage patient volume to drive reimbursement rates steadily down. Medicare and Medicaid will follow. Lean Sigma may not be the only way healthcare organizations will survive, but it’s a proven solution. In Lean Sigma–Rebuilding Capability in Healthcare, Dr. Wedgwood has presented a roadmap to successful implementation of Lean Sigma.”

–Richard H. Allen, Dr.P.H., Allen & Allen Consulting, LLC

Lean Sigma, widely proven in other industries, can offer even greater value in healthcare. In this guide, Ian Wedgwood walks you through all leadership aspects associated with planning, executing, sustaining, or reinvigorating Lean Sigma in your hospital, system, or clinic.

Drawing on his extensive experience helping healthcare organizations improve, Wedgwood explains Lean Sigma without “stat speak.” Focusing on care providers’ unique challenges, he offers a practical roadmap for making Lean or Six Sigma work. He demonstrates it through real case studies, illuminating key facets of change that are too often ignored.

Coverage includes

• How failure points in conventional change methods prevent performance improvement

• Lean Sigma’s structured change approach: why infrastructure and sequencing matter so much

• Integrating Lean Sigma with strategy and operations

• Elevating individual process performance

• Launching a Lean Sigma program or revitalizing a stalled initiative

• Learning from experience, and increasing program maturity

Whatever your Lean Sigma leadership role–from patient-facing staff to senior executive to performance improvement specialist–this guide gives you an indispensable foundation for success.

title: The Well-Balanced Leader: Interactive Learning Techniques to Help You Master the 9 Simple Behaviors of Outstanding Leadership
description:
Empower your people, your company—and yourself—with leadership egolibrium

egolibrium: the ability to toggle between egocentric and “other-centric” attitudes, values, and behaviors for organizational success

There’s no doubt about it: the very best leaders are deeply in tune with their behavior and understand the impact it has on others. As one of the world’s top trainers in the field of accelerated experiential learning, Ron Roberts understands this more keenly than anyone, and in The Well-Balanced Leader, he helps you re-envision your own behavior to become the best leader you can be.

Roberts makes the process of finding the perfect leadership balance—what he calls egolibrium—personally enriching and easy to achieve. He begins by identifying the nine human behavioral dichotomies that most affect the quality of leadership:

Nonjudgmental / Judgmental
Nondefensive / Defensive
Relinquishing Control / Controlling
Openness to learning / Know it all
Doing the right thing / Doing whatever you want
Patience / Impatience
Letting go / Holding on
Acceptance / Resistance
Other-centric / Egocentric

Everyone’s behaviors fall somewhere between each dichotomy. Using the activities, action steps, games, and thought exercises included for each pair, you’ll figure out exactly where your behaviors land, and then learn how to move that position in one direction or the other to find the right balance or your specific needs.

When you transcend your personal needs and focus on the needs of others and of the organization, everyone benefits—including you. The result is not only greater job satisfaction for people at all levels, but greater productivity— regardless of the organization’s field, product, or service.

The Well-Balanced Leader gives you the tools for making the small, incremental changes in behavior that lead to big changes in awareness—and huge changes in your leadership effectiveness.

Empoderar a tu gente, a tu empresa y a ti mismo, con egolibrio de liderazgo

egolibrio: la capacidad de luchar entre actitudes, valores y comportamientos egocéntricos y “otrocéntricos” para el éxito organizativo

No hay duda de ello: los mejores líderes están profundamente en sintonía con su comportamiento y entienden el impacto que tiene en otros. Como uno de los mejores entrenadores del mundo en el campo del aprendizaje experiencial acelerado, Ron Roberts entiende esto con más intensidad que nadie, y en The Well-Balanced Leader, él le ayuda a revisar su propio comportamiento para convertirse en el mejor líder que puede ser.

Roberts hace el proceso de encontrar el equilibrio de liderazgo perfecto —lo que él llama egolibrio— personalmente enriquecedor y fácil de lograr. Comienza identificando las nueve dicotomías conductuales humanas que más afectan la calidad del liderazgo:

No judgmental / Judgmental
Nodefensivo / Defensivo
Control de Renuncia / Control
Apertura al aprendizaje / Saberlo todo
Hacer lo correcto / Hacer lo que quieras
Paciencia / Impaciencia
Dejar ir / Esperar
Aceptación / Resistencia
Other-centric / Egocentric

Los comportamientos de todos caen entre cada dicotomía. Usando las actividades, pasos de acción, juegos y ejercicios de pensamiento incluidos para cada par, descubrirás exactamente dónde aterrizan tus comportamientos, y luego aprenderás a mover esa posición en una dirección u otra para encontrar el equilibrio adecuado o tus necesidades específicas.

Cuando usted trasciende sus necesidades personales y se centra en las necesidades de los demás y de la organización, todos se benefician —incluyendo a usted. El resultado no es sólo mayor satisfacción laboral para las personas a todos los niveles, sino mayor productividad, independientemente del campo, producto o servicio de la organización.

El Líder Well-Balanced le da las herramientas para hacer los pequeños cambios incrementales en el comportamiento que conducen a grandes cambios en la conciencia, y enormes cambios en su eficacia de liderazgo.

title: Academic Ethos Management
description: This topical and much needed book constitutes an important part of the debate on the integrity in an academic context as a sine qua non of responsible management education. Like you, we’ve all been listening to the highly publicized corporate scandals and instances of management misconduct that have eroded public faith. Simultaneously, management scholars and educators have begun to question the assumptions underlying the traditional management education, which in their view not only contributed to a recent moral crisis but has also failed to prepare students and executives for coping with the responsible leadership challenges and ethical dilemmas that face managers in contemporary corporations. This book discusses, with stimulating examples, how universities should bring alive their core values. Using case studies and examples from universities from all over the world, you’ll learn real practical advice and guidance, which explain in detail how you and other administrators and educators should discover, articulate, and institutionalize (implementation, securing and controlling by creating adequate policies, procedures process, etc.) university core values into academic daily activities and create a foundation for academy integrity.

Simultáneamente, los académicos y educadores de gestión han comenzado a cuestionar las suposiciones subyacentes a la educación de gestión tradicional, que a su juicio no sólo contribuyó a una crisis moral reciente, sino que tampoco ha preparado a estudiantes y ejecutivos para hacer frente a los retos de liderazgo responsables y a los dilemas éticos que enfrentan los directivos de las empresas contemporáneas. Este libro discute, con ejemplos estimulantes, cómo las universidades deben traer vivos sus valores fundamentales. Usando estudios de casos y ejemplos de universidades de todo el mundo, aprenderás consejos prácticos y guías reales, que explican detalladamente cómo usted y otros administradores y educadores deben descubrir, articular e institucionalizar (ejecución, seguridad y control creando políticas, procesos de procedimientos adecuados, etc.) valores básicos universitarios en actividades diarias académicas y crear una base para la integridad de la academia.

title: The Leadership Mind Switch: Rethinking How We Lead in the New World of Work

The world of business has completely transformed in recent years—and the pace of change will only increase in coming years. But one thing remains the same: Quality leadership is the hinge on which the fate of every organization swings.

Has varying—and sometimes conflicting—expectations of the company
Operates with different ideas about what success looks like
Uses, approaches, and even understands technology in different ways

The answers to these questions and many others are all here. You’ll learn how to be the kind of leader who is both firm in his or her decisions but maintains an air of approachability. You’ll learn how to drive high productivity while keeping your workers happy and satisfied in their jobs. And you’ll learn how to embrace new technologies without sacrificing the human touch—which is the hallmark of great leadership.

It will take unprecedented levels of agility, confidence, and fearlessness to lead into the future. Make the leadership mind switch to seize the competitive edge now in order to drive profits and growth tomorrow.

title: The Cornerstones of Engaging Leadership
description:
In the 21st Century, people are the competitive advantage. The talent and level of dedication of an organization's workforce make the difference in achieving success.

The traditional command-oriented leadership style is not enough to keep today's employees motivated—they need to be engaged. They need passion, connection, and inspiration, and a willingness to put forth their best efforts to benefit themselves and their organization.

The Cornerstones of Engaging Leadership connects what we know about engagement on an organizational level to what an individual leader can do to increase engagement. Using real-world examples, Wilson reveals the key actions leaders must take to connect with and engage others:

Build trust
Leverage unique motivators
Manage performance from a people-centric perspective
Engage emotions

By committing to these four cornerstones of engaging leadership, leaders can unleash the potential of others and inspire effective performance. Through practice tools and exercises (all available for download on a supplemental CD-ROM), readers are challenged to explore, reflect upon, and apply key concepts and techniques of the engaging leader approach.

NOTE: This title includes additional digital media when purchased in print format. For this digital book edition, media content may not be included. Contact the publisher's customer service directly for assistance.

En el siglo XXI, la gente es la ventaja competitiva. El talento y el nivel de dedicación de la fuerza laboral de una organización marcan la diferencia en el logro del éxito.

El estilo de liderazgo tradicional orientado al mando no es suficiente para mantener motivados a los empleados de hoy, necesitan ser comprometidos. Necesitan pasión, conexión e inspiración, y una voluntad de poner en marcha sus mejores esfuerzos para beneficiarse a sí mismos y a su organización.

Las Cornerstones de Liderazgo Compromiso conecta lo que sabemos sobre el compromiso a nivel organizativo a lo que un líder individual puede hacer para aumentar el compromiso. Utilizando ejemplos del mundo real, Wilson revela las acciones clave que los líderes deben tomar para conectarse con y involucrar a otros:

Construir confianza
Aprovechamiento de motivadores únicos
Gestionar el rendimiento desde una perspectiva centrada en las personas
Engage emociones

Al comprometerse con estas cuatro piedras angulares de liderazgo atractivo, los líderes pueden desencadenar el potencial de otros e inspirar un desempeño eficaz. A través de herramientas y ejercicios prácticos (todos disponibles para su descarga en un CD-ROM suplementario), los lectores son desafiados a explorar, reflexionar y aplicar conceptos y técnicas claves del enfoque líder atractivo.

title: The Positive Organization
description: Beholden to accepted assumptions about people and organizations, too many enterprises waste human potential. Robert Quinn shows how to defy convention and create organizations where people feel fully engaged and continually rewarded, where both individually and collectively they flourish and exceed expectations.The problem is that leaders are following a negative and constraining “mental map” that insists organizations must be rigid, top-down hierarchies and that the people in them are driven mainly by self-interest and fear. But leaders can adopt a different mental map, one where organizations are networks of fluid, evolving relationships and where people are motivated by a desire to grow, learn, and serve a larger goal. Using dozens of memorable stories, Quinn describes specific actions leaders can take to facilitate the emergence of this organizational culture—helping people gain a sense of purpose, engage in authentic conversations, see new possibilities, and sacrifice for the common good. The book includes the Positive Organization Generator, a tool that provides 100 real-life practices from positive organizations and helps you reinvent them to fit your specific needs. With the POG you can identify and implement the practices that will have the greatest impact on your organization. At its heart, the book helps leaders to see new possibilities that lie within the acknowledged realities of organizational life. It provides five keys for learning to be "bilingual"--speaking the conventional language of business as well as the language of the positive organization.  When leaders can do this, they are able to make real and lasting change.
translatedDescription: He aquí que las suposiciones aceptadas sobre personas y organizaciones, demasiadas empresas desperdician el potencial humano. Robert Quinn muestra cómo desafiar la convención y crear organizaciones donde la gente se siente plenamente comprometida y constantemente recompensada, donde tanto individual como colectivamente florecen y superan las expectativas. El problema es que los líderes están siguiendo un “ mapeo mental” negativo y restrictivo que insiste en que las organizaciones deben ser jerarquías rígidas y de arriba abajo y que las personas en ellas son impulsadas principalmente por el interés propio y el miedo. Pero los líderes pueden adoptar un mapa mental diferente, uno donde las organizaciones son redes de fluidos, relaciones en evolución y donde las personas están motivadas por el deseo de crecer, aprender y servir un objetivo más grande. Utilizando docenas de historias memorables, Quinn describe acciones específicas que los líderes pueden tomar para facilitar el surgimiento de esta cultura organizativa —ayudar a las personas a obtener un sentido de propósito, entablar conversaciones auténticas, ver nuevas posibilidades y sacrificarse por el bien común. El libro incluye al Generador de Organizaciones Positivas, una herramienta que proporciona 100 prácticas de la vida real de organizaciones positivas y le ayuda a reinventarlas para satisfacer sus necesidades específicas. Con el POG usted puede identificar e implementar las prácticas que tendrán el mayor impacto en su organización. En su corazón, el libro ayuda a los líderes a ver nuevas posibilidades que se encuentran dentro de las realidades reconocidas de la vida organizativa. Proporciona cinco claves para aprender a ser "bilingüe" -hablando el lenguaje convencional del negocio, así como el lenguaje de la organización positiva. Cuando los líderes pueden hacer esto, son capaces de hacer un cambio real y duradero.

title: Must-Win Battles: How to Win Them, Again and Again
description: Must-Win Battles shows leaders exactly how to identify the 3 to 5 critical challenges most likely to make or break their businesses -- and then mobilize people and resources to successfully execute on them. This book draws on the authors' exceptional experience as world-class consultants and leading-edge business researchers, and builds on the highly successful executive program they created for IMD, one of the world's best business schools. The authors show leaders how to cut through uncoordinated initiatives, create a short list of true "must-wins," focus relentlessly on them, and infuse their organizations with renewed energy and effectiveness. Along the way, discover how to recognize which victories will make the greatest difference, avoid unwinnable battles, drive consensus when somebody's ox is inevitably being gored, make sure must-win battles are specific and measurable, and change the behavior of your top management team to lock in this laser-sharp focus for future battles.
translatedDescription: Must-Win Battles muestra a los líderes exactamente cómo identificar los 3 a 5 retos críticos más probables para hacer o romper sus negocios, y luego movilizar a las personas y recursos para ejecutarlos con éxito. Este libro se basa en la experiencia excepcional de los autores como consultores de clase mundial e investigadores de negocios de vanguardia, y se basa en el programa ejecutivo altamente exitoso que crearon para IMD, una de las mejores escuelas de negocios del mundo. Los autores muestran a los líderes cómo cortar a través de iniciativas no coordinadas, crear una lista corta de verdaderos "debidos", enfocarse implacablemente en ellos, e infundir sus organizaciones con energía y eficacia renovadas. A lo largo del camino, descubra cómo reconocer qué victorias harán la mayor diferencia, evite batallas invencibles, conduzca el consenso cuando el buey de alguien está siendo inevitablemente engullido, asegúrate de que las batallas entrelazadas sean específicas y mensurables, y cambie el comportamiento de tu equipo directivo superior para bloquear en este foco de láser para futuras batallas.

title: The Wisdom of Failure: How to Learn the Tough Leadership Lessons Without Paying the Price
description:
The "how-not-to" leadership book

There is a paradox in leadership: we can only succeed by knowing failure. Every accomplished leader knows there are minefields of failures that need to be navigated in order to succeed. Wouldn't it be great to have the insights to help you prevent from making avoidable mistakes? Unfortunately, in business talking about mistakes can be taboo, and, at a certain level, learning from failure is not an option. Weinzimmer and McConoughey speak frankly about the things that are difficult to talk about – the unvarnished truths necessary to become a successful leader.

Based on a groundbreaking 7-year study of what almost 1000 managers across 21 industries really think about lessons from failures

Includes exclusive interview material from CEOs at a wide range of organizations, including major firms such as Caterpillar, Priceline.com, and Allstate; startups; and entrepreneurial small businesses

Drills down into failure to uncover the strategies that aspiring leaders need in order to avoid the most damning leadership mistakes: unbalanced orchestration, drama management, and reckless vanity

Learning from the mistakes of others is a necessary part of the journey of effective leadership, and this book offers an indispensable guide to learning these powerful lessons—without paying the price of failure.
translatedDescription:
El libro de liderazgo "cómo no"

Basado en un innovador estudio de 7 años de lo que casi 1000 gerentes de 21 industrias realmente piensan en lecciones de fracasos

Incluye material de entrevista exclusivo de CEOs en una amplia gama de organizaciones, incluyendo grandes empresas como Caterpillar, Priceline.com y Allstate; startups; y pequeñas empresas emprendedoras

Perfora hacia abajo en el fracaso de descubrir las estrategias que necesitan los líderes aspirantes para evitar los errores de liderazgo más malditos: orquestación desequilibrada, gestión del drama y vanidad imprudente

Aprender de los errores de otros es una parte necesaria del viaje de liderazgo eficaz, y este libro ofrece una guía indispensable para aprender estas lecciones poderosas, sin pagar el precio del fracaso.

title: Developing the Next Generation of Enterprise Leaders
description:
A survey of top business executives from major international organizations found that 79% said it was extremely important to have leaders who act on behalf of the entire organization, not just their units. The rest said it was very important. Nearly 65% said they expected at least half of their senior and midlevel managers to behave as enterprise leaders — that is, executives who are as successful at serving the needs of the enterprise as they are at growing the units they head. The expectation that managers will know what’s happening elsewhere in the enterprise is rising, authors Douglas A. Ready and M. Ellen Peebles write, but few organizations have been set up to support the development of such enterprise leaders.

So how are managers learning to become effective enterprise leaders, and how can organizations encourage their development? The authors surveyed and interviewed scores of executives from the Americas, Europe, and Asia, and focused on three companies: Pfizer, Li & Fung, and Unilever. They found that regardless of the business or the location, enterprise leaders developed their capabilities in similar ways — through a combination of deliberate personal development, high-level mentoring, and opportunities afforded by their work that enabled strong unit performers to become even more effective as enterprise leaders.

According to the authors, the essence of enterprise leadership lies in combining two often incompatible roles — those of builder and broker. That means executives need to build their unit’s vision and integrate it into the wider corporate vision, clarifying where the enterprise is going and how their teams can best contribute, both within and beyond unit boundaries. They must build unit capabilities and share resources and business know-how across units to contribute to enterprisewide organizational capability.

Balancing the goals of the unit with the broader interests of the enterprise can be difficult, the authors concede. Having come up the ranks in silos, managers acquire strong building skills — not the brokering skills top leaders said they needed. From their interviews, the authors identified six components of what they present as a mindset for the successful enterprise leader: a heightened sense of place; a broad sense of context; a sharp sense of perspective; a powerful sense of community; a deep sense of purpose; and an abiding sense of resiliency.
translatedDescription:
Una encuesta de altos ejecutivos empresariales de las principales organizaciones internacionales encontró que el 79% dijo que era extremadamente importante tener líderes que actúan en nombre de toda la organización, no sólo sus unidades. El resto dijo que era muy importante. Casi el 65% dijo que esperaban que al menos la mitad de sus directivos de nivel superior y medio se comportaran como líderes empresariales, es decir, ejecutivos que tienen tanto éxito al atender las necesidades de la empresa como están creciendo las unidades que dirigen. La expectativa de que los gerentes sabrán lo que está sucediendo en otras partes de la empresa está aumentando, escriben los autores Douglas A. Ready y M. Ellen Peebles, pero pocas organizaciones han sido creadas para apoyar el desarrollo de tales líderes empresariales.

¿Cómo aprenden los directivos a convertirse en líderes empresariales eficaces y cómo pueden las organizaciones fomentar su desarrollo? Los autores encuestaron y entrevistaron a decenas de ejecutivos de América, Europa y Asia, y se centraron en tres empresas: Pfizer, Li & Fung y Unilever. Encontraron que, independientemente del negocio o el lugar, los líderes empresariales desarrollaron sus capacidades de manera similar, mediante una combinación de desarrollo personal deliberado, mentoría de alto nivel y oportunidades que les brinda su trabajo que permitieron a los intérpretes de unidades fuertes llegar a ser aún más eficaces como líderes empresariales.

Según los autores, la esencia del liderazgo empresarial radica en combinar dos roles a menudo incompatibles: los de constructor y corredor. Eso significa que los ejecutivos necesitan construir la visión de su unidad e integrarla en la visión corporativa más amplia, aclarando a dónde va la empresa y cómo sus equipos pueden contribuir mejor, tanto dentro como fuera de los límites unitarios. Deben crear capacidades unitarias y compartir recursos y conocimientos empresariales en todas las dependencias para contribuir a la capacidad organizativa de toda la empresa.

Es difícil equilibrar los objetivos de la unidad con los intereses más amplios de la empresa, según los autores. Habiendo alcanzado las filas en silos, los directivos adquieren fuertes habilidades de construcción, no las habilidades de intermediación líderes dijeron que necesitaban. Desde sus entrevistas, los autores identificaron seis componentes de lo que presentan como una mentalidad para el exitoso líder de la empresa: un sentido elevado del lugar; un sentido amplio del contexto; un sentido agudo de la perspectiva; un sentido poderoso de la comunidad; un sentido profundo de propósito; y un sentido constante de resiliencia.

title: Work with Me
description:
Lead from any level with the power of buy-in

Work with Me shows you how to master the art of the 'buy-in.' You achieve better results when people go along with your ideas because they want to, not because they have to; the key is knowing how to build that kind of commitment This is the art of buy-in, and it's one of the most powerful skills you can have. When people are fully on board, they bring their full selves to the project. This drives their priorities, their performance, their innovation and ultimately, your outcome. Buy-in sits at the heart of creative and collaborative cultures; it drives highly adaptive and nimble teams. This book is a how-to guide for achieving buy-in, regardless of your leadership level. It's not about using power and authority, it's about building support and commitment to your ideas and initiatives. You can lead from any level, even laterally, and have a positive impact on the way things are done in your organisation. This book is your coach for speaking up, standing out and embracing the changes that fuel engaged workplaces and better business.

Build engagement, agreement, commitment and ownership
Overcome obstacles and drive stellar performance
Deliver optimal outcomes through enthusiastic collaboration
Boost creativity, passion, energy and focus

In the shift from traditional industrial economies to a value-focused economy of ideas, organisations thrive on great ideas, but those ideas don't count unless they're actually implemented. Work with Me shows you how to get people on board so you can bring great ideas to life.
translatedDescription:
Lead desde cualquier nivel con el poder de buy-in

Cuando la gente está completamente a bordo, traen sus seres completos al proyecto. Esto impulsa sus prioridades, su rendimiento, su innovación y, en última instancia, su resultado. Buy-in se sienta en el corazón de las culturas creativas y colaborativas; conduce equipos altamente adaptables y ágiles. Este libro es una guía para lograr la entrada, independientemente de su nivel de liderazgo. No se trata de usar el poder y la autoridad, sino de construir apoyo y compromiso con sus ideas e iniciativas. Usted puede conducir desde cualquier nivel, incluso lateralmente, y tener un impacto positivo en la forma en que las cosas se hacen en su organización. Este libro es su entrenador para hablar, destacar y abrazar los cambios que alimentan los lugares de trabajo y mejores negocios.

Crear compromiso, acuerdo, compromiso y propiedad
Obstáculos superpuestos y rendimiento estelar de la unidad
Ofrecer resultados óptimos mediante una colaboración entusiasta
creatividad, pasión, energía y enfoque

En el cambio de las economías industriales tradicionales a una economía de ideas centrada en el valor, las organizaciones prosperan con grandes ideas, pero esas ideas no cuentan a menos que sean implementadas. Trabajar conmigo te muestra cómo conseguir gente a bordo para que puedas traer grandes ideas a la vida.

title: ...And Dignity for All: Unlocking Greatness through Values-Based Leadership
description: And Dignity for All is about leading with values, leading by example, and - in so doing - unleashing the astonishing commitment and innovation that are buried within your organization right now. Discover how Jim Despain and his colleagues used values-based management to transform Caterpillar's Track-Type Tractors Division into one of the firm's key profit centers. Jim's honesty and ability to rise from the ashes of his mistakes are inspirational. His respect for the common worker and personal search for dignity and self-worth lead him to a new kind of leadership. And his transformation of a struggling organization provides a powerful blueprint for transforming your own - you can make it happen, too.

Y su transformación de una organización en lucha proporciona un poderoso plan para transformar la suya - usted puede hacer que suceda, también.

title: Beyond The Call: Why Some of Your Team Go the Extra Mile and Others Don't Show
description:
Why some team members go the extra mile while others don't--and how to get more out of everyone

Business leaders know that some members of their teams go above and beyond while others get by doing the bare minimum. The question on everyone's lips is how to turn every member of your organization into a top performer. Beyond the Call uses case studies, the real-world stories of real managers, and groundbreaking research from NYU's Stern School of Business, to answer important questions about performance and offer real solutions for building high-performing organizations and teams. This book will show you how to coax every member of you team to do more, leaving behind mediocrity for excellence.

title: Business Express: Effective mentoring
Remember That Leaders Are Always “On Stage”
description:
This Element is an excerpt from The Truth About Being a Leader (9780131873384) by Karen Otazo. Available in print and digital formats.

How to perform your leader “role” all day long, in front of all your audiences.

Actors turn on like a light as they become their characters or assume their public personae. Their high energy captures the audience. Good leaders do the same thing. However, when you’re a leader, your audience is an all-day one–every follower, contact, and client, right down to your company driver. You can’t slip out of your leader role until you’re alone.

title: The Truth About Managing People... and Nothing But The Truth
description:
This isn't just "someone's opinion"...It's the first, definitive, evidence-based guide to effective management. In The Truth About Managing People...and Nothing but the Truth, Robbins delivers principles you can rely on throughout your entire management career--regardless of your organization, role or title. This is a management book that cuts through the soft opinion and conjecture books that have dominated the business shelves in recent years and shows what management researchers know actually works, or doesn't work, when it comes to managing people.

Drawing on the author's 30+ years of research and textbook writing experience, Robbins has distilled the results of thousands of research studies on human behavior into over 60 proven "truths" that can transform how you manage people--and the results that are achieved. The author provides guidance to you organized around key, human-behavior-related problem areas that managers face (hiring, motivation, leadership, communication, team building, conflict management, job design, evaluating performance and coping with change), along with guidance to help you apply the information and improve your managerial effectiveness.
translatedDescription:
Esto no es sólo "la opinión de alguien"... Es la primera, definitiva, guía basada en evidencia para una gestión eficaz. En la verdad sobre la gestión de las personas... y nada más que la verdad, Robbins ofrece principios en los que puedes confiar durante toda tu carrera de gestión, independientemente de tu organización, papel o título. Este es un libro de gestión que recorta los libros de opinión y conjetura suaves que han dominado los estantes de negocios en los últimos años y muestra lo que los investigadores de gestión saben que realmente funciona, o no funciona, cuando se trata de gestionar la gente.

Basándose en 30 años más de experiencia en investigación y escritura de libros de texto del autor, Robbins ha destilado los resultados de miles de estudios de investigación sobre comportamiento humano en más de 60 "verdades" probadas que pueden transformar cómo administras a las personas, y los resultados que se logran. El autor proporciona orientación a usted organizada en torno a áreas problemáticas clave relacionadas con los comportamientos humanos que los directivos enfrentan (contratación, motivación, liderazgo, comunicación, creación de equipos, gestión de conflictos, diseño de empleo, evaluación de desempeño y afrontamiento con cambio), junto con orientación para ayudarle a aplicar la información y mejorar su eficacia de gestión.

title: Developing Leadership Abilities
description:
The prentice Hall NetEffect series encompasses training for specific business areas, such as learning skills, job skills, management skills, and technology soft skills. Courses are available in print, on CD-ROM, or over the Internet. For more information on the NetEffect series, go to www.prenhall.com/training

Developing Leadership Abilities teaches specific skills that matter most for those assuming a leadership role. Their step-by-step approach helps extend and refine leadership insights and techniques.
translatedDescription:
La serie prentice Hall NetEffect abarca la capacitación para áreas empresariales específicas, como habilidades de aprendizaje, habilidades de trabajo, habilidades de gestión y habilidades tecnológicas suaves. Los cursos están disponibles en forma impresa, en CD-ROM o en Internet. Para obtener más información sobre la serie NetEffect, visite www.prenhall.com/training

Desarrollar capacidades de liderazgo enseña habilidades específicas que más importan para aquellos que asumen un papel de liderazgo. Su enfoque paso a paso ayuda a ampliar y perfeccionar las ideas y técnicas de liderazgo.

title: Internalizing Strengths: An Overlooked Way of Overcoming Weaknesses in Managers
description: Because executives tend to be problem solvers, they typically focus on weaknesses when they want to improve their performance. This approach can be helpful but there is another that can be just as effective: recognizing strengths. A senior manager whom the author interviewed said this about a top person: "If he saw his own strengths and internalized them, a lot of his weaknesses would go away." In this report, the author explains why it is critical to recognize strengths in order to improve performance and why it is often difficult to get that notion across to executives. For practicing managers and those who develop them, this report offers sound but often neglected developmental principles for overcoming weaknesses.
translatedDescription: Debido a que los ejecutivos tienden a ser solucionadores de problemas, normalmente se centran en debilidades cuando quieren mejorar su rendimiento. Este enfoque puede ser útil pero hay otro que puede ser igual de eficaz: reconocer fortalezas. Un gerente superior al que el autor entrevistó dijo esto acerca de una persona superior: "Si viera sus propias fortalezas e interiorizalas, muchas de sus debilidades desaparecerían." En este informe, el autor explica por qué es fundamental reconocer las fortalezas para mejorar el desempeño y por qué a menudo es difícil conseguir que esa noción se transmita a los ejecutivos. Para los administradores y los que los desarrollan, este informe ofrece principios de desarrollo sólidos pero a menudo descuidados para superar las deficiencias.

title: The Rules of Management, 3rd Edition
description: Some people find management so easy. They glide effortlessly onwards and upwards through the system, the politics, the people problems, the impossible targets and the work overload. They always seem to say the right thing, do the right thing and know instinctively how to handle every situation.  Is there something they know that the rest of us don’t? Is it something that we can all learn? The answer is a resounding yes. They know the Rules of Management. These golden principles show you how to inspire your team to perform (and what to do when it doesn’t). They reveal the secrets of managing yourself and your team in a way that gets results. The first edition of The Rules of Management became an instant classic, topping business bestseller charts around the world. Real managers from all kinds of backgrounds have testified as to the positive and immediate effect the Rules have had on their success. Your life will be easier. Your successes will be greater. And when you are headhunted or promoted (again) nobody will be surprised. Least of all you. Others can be good. You’ll be better.
translatedDescription: Algunas personas encuentran la gestión tan fácil. Ellos deslizan sin esfuerzo hacia adelante y hacia arriba a través del sistema, la política, los problemas de la gente, los objetivos imposibles y la sobrecarga de trabajo. Siempre parecen decir lo correcto, hacer lo correcto y saber instintivamente cómo manejar cada situación. ¿Hay algo que ellos saben que el resto de nosotros no? ¿Es algo que todos podemos aprender? La respuesta es un sí resonante. Conocen las Reglas de Gestión. Estos principios dorados le muestran cómo inspirar a su equipo a realizar (y qué hacer cuando no lo hace). Ellos revelan los secretos de manejarse a ti mismo y a tu equipo de una manera que consigue resultados. La primera edición de The Rules of Management se convirtió en un clásico instantáneo, topping business bestseller gráficos en todo el mundo. Los administradores reales de todo tipo de antecedentes han demostrado el efecto positivo e inmediato que las Reglas han tenido en su éxito. Tu vida será más fácil. Sus éxitos serán mayores. Y cuando seas cazado o ascendido (de nuevo) nadie se sorprenderá. Al menos tú. Otros pueden ser buenos. Estarás mejor.

title: The Leader's Climb: A Business Tale of Rising to the New Leadership Challenge
description: “Adam was stuck.” And with this simple phrase, The Leader’s Climb introduces the reader to an engaging tale of how leaders often ascend quickly to the top, only to unknowingly slip down a path of decline—until it is too late. In this novel approach to the subject, set against the backdrop of a rock-climbing vacation gone awry, executive coaches Bob Parsanko and Paul Heagen draw from decades of success with business executives to reveal an all-too-familiar path of leadership struggles. The protagonist, Adam, is capable and well-meaning but has confidence bordering on hubris, and blind spots that could be the end of him. That is, until unlikely encounters with a park ranger and a home handyman, who become confidants and mentors, reveal new insights to Adam. Through their wisdom, and the realities of the hard knocks of business, Adam gets “unstuck” and begins to turn around his life and career with three fundamental principles of personal growth: awareness, acceptance, and abundance.
translatedDescription: Adam estaba atascado. Y con esta frase sencilla, la Escala del Líder presenta al lector una historia atractiva de cómo los líderes a menudo ascienden rápidamente a la cima, sólo para deslizarse sin saberlo por un camino de declive, hasta que sea demasiado tarde. En este enfoque novedoso del tema, puesto en el telón de fondo de unas vacaciones de escalada de roca, los entrenadores ejecutivos Bob Parsanko y Paul Heagen dibujan de décadas de éxito con ejecutivos de negocios para revelar un camino totalmente familiar de luchas de liderazgo. El protagonista, Adán, es capaz y bien Significado pero tiene confianza en el borde de la arrogancia, y manchas ciegas que podrían ser el fin de él. Es decir, hasta encuentros improbables con un guardaparques y un acompañante de casa, que se convierten en confidentes y mentores, revelan nuevas ideas a Adán. A través de su sabiduría, y de las realidades de los duros golpes de negocio, Adán se vuelve "instuck" y comienza a dar la vuelta a su vida y carrera con tres principios fundamentales del crecimiento personal: conciencia, aceptación y abundancia.

title: Meaningful Workplaces: Reframing How and Where We Work
description:
"Anyone who has a position of leadership in your organization should read Meaningful Workplaces. From the CEO to the front-line manager, this book will change the way people think about work. It is truly a must read for people creating the workplace of the future."

-- Paul Butler, Managing Director and Founder of GlobalEdg (recently retired -- Director Global Learning and Organizational Development, Proctor &Gamble/Gillette)

"Meaningful Workplaces is a must-read for today's workforce. It sagely advises organizations how to create cultures that provide a sense of belonging, a feeling of trust, caring, and shared celebration."

-- Dr. Peggy Dolet, Director of Human Resources, American Society for Engineering Education

"Chalofsky's Meaningful Workplaces models do a great job of reframing the discussion about work and values. He provides excellent examples of organizations that have made measurable and sustainable strides in achieving "integrated wholeness" in today's competitive environment. I found it both practical and insightful."

-- Kimo Kippen former Vice President, Center of Excellence, Marriott International, former Chair, ASTD Board of Governors, and Executive in Residence at Catholic University

"Dr. Chalofsky captures the essence of what motivates people to work beyond material gain. Grounded in decades of organizational research and practice, it is a source that can be trusted. I highly recommend this book to students of organizational studies, company leaders, and people seeking answers to the questions of what it takes to create and sustain meaningful work and humane workplaces."

-- Dr. Susan Gayle, Chief Administrative Officer, Promontory Interfinancial Network, LLC

"Chalofsky's experience and expertise shine through as he takes readers on a journey about how humanistic organizations lead to increased joy, passion, learning, personal growth, high performance, and bottom-line success. This excellent text ties years of concepts into a coordinated whole culture, learning, engagement, motivation, community, and work-life integration. Chalofsky provides concepts, practical approaches, and realistic examples for students, leaders, practitioners, and educators."

-- Dr. Virginia Bianco-Mathis Chair, Department of Management, School of Business, Marymount University, Managing Partner, Strategic Performance Group
translatedDescription:
"Cualquiera que tenga una posición de liderazgo en su organización debe leer Lugares de trabajo significativos. Desde el CEO hasta el gerente de primera línea, este libro cambiará la forma en que la gente piensa en el trabajo. Es realmente un deber leer para las personas que crean el lugar de trabajo del futuro."

-- Paul Butler, Director Gerente y Fundador de GlobalEdg (recientemente retirado - Director Global Learning and Organizational Development, Proctor &Gamble/Gillette)

"Los lugares de trabajo significativos son un deber de leer para la fuerza laboral de hoy. Le aconseja a las organizaciones cómo crear culturas que ofrezcan un sentido de pertenencia, un sentimiento de confianza, cuidado y celebración compartida".

-- Dr. Peggy Dolet, Director de Recursos Humanos, American Society for Engineering Education

"Chalofsky's Meaningful Workplaces modelos hacen un gran trabajo de reframing la discusión sobre el trabajo y los valores. Ofrece excelentes ejemplos de organizaciones que han hecho avances mensurables y sostenibles en el logro de la "alteza integrada" en el ambiente competitivo de hoy. Lo encontré práctico y perspicaz."

-- Kimo Kippen ex Vicepresidente, Centro de Excelencia, Marriott International, ex Presidente, Junta de Gobernadores de la ASTD y Ejecutivo en Residencia en la Universidad Católica

"El Dr. Chalofsky captura la esencia de lo que motiva a la gente a trabajar más allá de la ganancia material. Basado en décadas de investigación y práctica organizativa, es una fuente que se puede confiar. Recomiendo altamente este libro a estudiantes de estudios organizativos, líderes de empresas y personas que buscan respuestas a las preguntas de lo que se necesita para crear y mantener trabajos significativos y lugares de trabajo humanos".

-- Dr. Susan Gayle, Oficial Administrativo Jefe, Promontory Interfinancial Network, LLC

"La experiencia y la experiencia deChalofsky brillan a medida que lleva a los lectores en un viaje sobre cómo las organizaciones humanistas conducen a una mayor alegría, pasión, aprendizaje, crecimiento personal, alto rendimiento y éxito en la línea de abajo. Este excelente texto vincula años de conceptos a una cultura integral coordinada, aprendizaje, compromiso, motivación, comunidad e integración de la vida laboral. Chalofsky proporciona conceptos, enfoques prácticos y ejemplos realistas para estudiantes, líderes, practicantes y educadores".

-- Dr. Virginia Bianco-Mathis Chair, Department of Management, School of Business, Marymount University, Managing Partner, Strategic Performance Group

title: The Potency of Shortcuts in Decision-Making
description: Recent research shows that rather than engaging in comprehensive decision-making, CEOs may be better off relying on heuristics — simple rules of thumb that require little information and analysis. Often based on direct learning experiences, heuristics are used consciously and deliberately, and frequently result in superior decision outcomes.
translatedDescription: Investigaciones recientes muestran que en lugar de participar en la toma de decisiones integrales, los CEOs pueden estar mejor dependiendo de la heurística — reglas simples del pulgar que requieren poca información y análisis. A menudo basados en experiencias de aprendizaje directo, las heurísticas se utilizan consciente y deliberadamente, y con frecuencia resultan en resultados de decisión superiores.

title: Leadership in Action: Leading the Way to Employee Satisfaction
description: Even slight differences in managerial effectiveness can affect subordinates' satisfaction with organizational climate.
translatedDescription: Incluso ligeras diferencias en la eficacia de la gestión pueden afectar la satisfacción de los subordinados con el clima organizativo.

title: Standing in the Fire
description: Real organizational change isn't brought about by decree, pressure, permission, or even persuasion. Sustained change comes when people are passionately and personally committed to a future that they have helped to shape. If you want to turn your organization's cynics into owners, give them a voice in the decisions that impact their work. Consensus Through Conversation shows how.Consensus is a cooperative process in which all of a group's members develop and agree to actively support a decision. It's not mere acquiescence—consensus goes several steps beyond, transforming people from resigned instruction-followers to dedicated champions of an idea. Larry Dressler shows you exactly how to prepare for a successful consensus-building process, takes you step-by-step through that process, and offers tips for success and traps to avoid. Throughout, he provides a host of tools and examples that make this an eminently practical and immediately useful guide. Consensus Through Conversation will give you the tools you need to use consensus effectively in your organization. It is a handy, vital reference that you will turn to again and again in your efforts to tackle high stakes issues, make high quality decisions, and build enthusiasm and commitment to action.
translatedDescription: El cambio organizativo real no se produce por decreto, presión, permiso o incluso persuasión. El cambio sostenido viene cuando las personas están comprometidas apasionada y personalmente con un futuro que han ayudado a dar forma. Si quieres convertir los cínicos de tu organización en propietarios, dales una voz en las decisiones que impactan su trabajo. El consenso a través de la conversación muestra cómo. El consenso es un proceso cooperativo en el que todos los miembros de un grupo desarrollan y aceptan apoyar activamente una decisión. No es una mera aquiescencia: el consenso va varios pasos más allá, transformando a la gente de los seguidores de instrucción resignados a los campeones dedicados de una idea. Larry Dressler le muestra exactamente cómo prepararse para un proceso exitoso de creación de consenso, le lleva paso a paso a través de ese proceso, y ofrece consejos para el éxito y trampas para evitar. A lo largo de todo, proporciona una serie de herramientas y ejemplos que hacen de esta una guía eminentemente práctica e inmediatamente útil. El consenso a través de la conversación le dará las herramientas que necesita para utilizar el consenso de manera efectiva en su organización. Es una referencia útil y vital a la que recurrirá una y otra vez en sus esfuerzos por abordar cuestiones de alto riesgo, tomar decisiones de alta calidad y crear entusiasmo y compromiso con la acción.

title: Brilliant Leader, 2nd Edition
description:
Get the best out of your teams and yourself with the practical blueprint for leadership success.

Brilliant Leader will show you how to find and nurture the best talent around. It will teach you how to manage work and team synergy so you can achieve maximum results and act and communicate as a true leader.
translatedDescription:
Obtenga lo mejor de sus equipos y usted mismo con el plan práctico para el éxito del liderazgo.

Brillante Líder le mostrará cómo encontrar y nutrir el mejor talento alrededor. Te enseñará a manejar la sinergia de trabajo y equipo para que puedas lograr resultados máximos y actuar y comunicarte como un verdadero líder.

title: Leadership in Action: Bridging Boundaries: Meeting the Challenge of Workplace Diversity
description: In today's globally diverse and increasingly interconnected world, social identity boundaries rub together, pull apart, and collide in the workplace. When identity divides open up, people look to leaders to bridge the gaps. By employing four tactics—suspending, reframing, nesting, and weaving— leaders can facilitate positive cross-boundary interactions.
translatedDescription: En el mundo globalmente diverso y cada vez más interconectado, los límites de identidad social se frotan, se separan y chocan en el lugar de trabajo. Cuando la identidad se divide, la gente mira a los líderes para salvar las brechas. Empleando cuatro tácticas —suspenso, reabastecimiento, anidación y tejido— los líderes pueden facilitar interacciones transfronterizas positivas.

title: Leadership in Action: A Question of Leadership: What Does Effective Leadership Look Like in a Virtual Work Environment?
description: As organizations deal with advances in information and communication technologies, efforts to accommodate work-life balance and flex scheduling, and attempts to comply with the Americans with Disabilities Act, they are using virtual work to break down boundaries and connect employees—regardless of geographical location or subunit affiliation.
translatedDescription: A medida que las organizaciones se ocupan de los avances en las tecnologías de la información y las comunicaciones, los esfuerzos por acomodar el equilibrio entre la vida laboral y la programación flexible, y los intentos de cumplir con la Ley de los estadounidenses con discapacidad, están utilizando trabajos virtuales para descomponer las fronteras y conectar a los empleados, independientemente de su ubicación geográfica o filiación subunidad.

title: Disrespected Employees Are Quitting. What Can Managers Do Differently?
description: The typical signals of respect largely necessitate in-person interaction. They are subtle, easier to provide in informal settings, and contagious to others when everyone is in the same physical space — conditions that are more difficult to replicate in virtual settings. To effectively show respect for a remote workforce, managers should use time, validate employee performance, send tangible respect signals, and offer visibility for employees and their work.
translatedDescription: Las señales típicas del respeto requieren en gran medida la interacción en persona. Son sutiles, más fáciles de proporcionar en entornos informales, y contagiosos a otros cuando todo el mundo está en el mismo espacio físico — condiciones que son más difíciles de reproducir en entornos virtuales. Para demostrar el respeto de una fuerza de trabajo remota, los administradores deben utilizar el tiempo, validar el desempeño de los empleados, enviar señales de respeto tangibles y ofrecer visibilidad para los empleados y su trabajo.

title: Followership
description: Followers dominate all organizations, but a preoccupation with leaders hinders the consideration of the importance of followers and the relationship between followers and leaders. Followership: What It Takes to Lead will teach you how to become a better leader by becoming a better follower. The book includes chapters on the topics of: leadership theory, followership theory, preparation for the job, understanding what is required for the job, communication, initiative, positive attitude, responsibility, problem solving, and teamwork. It also provides suggestions for becoming an exemplary follower, which will demonstrate and manifest the skills associated with leadership as well as bridge the gap between leadership training and followership.
translatedDescription: Los seguidores dominan todas las organizaciones, pero una preocupación con los líderes dificulta el examen de la importancia de los seguidores y la relación entre los seguidores y los líderes. Seguidor: Lo que se necesita para liderar le enseñará a convertirse en un mejor líder convirtiéndose en un mejor seguidor. El libro incluye capítulos sobre los temas de: teoría de liderazgo, teoría de seguimiento, preparación para el trabajo, comprensión de lo que se requiere para el trabajo, comunicación, iniciativa, actitud positiva, responsabilidad, solución de problemas y trabajo en equipo. También ofrece sugerencias para convertirse en un seguidor ejemplar, que demostrará y manifestará las habilidades asociadas con el liderazgo, así como reducir la brecha entre la formación de liderazgo y el seguimiento.

title: The John Adair Lexicon of Leadership
description: John Adair's Leadership Lexicon is an all-in-one volume of his ground breaking and influential works on leadership. Including the international best-seller Leadership of Muhammad, it explores the nature of motivation, strategy and the skills needed to become a leader.
translatedDescription: El Liderazgo de John Adair Lexicon es un volumen todo en uno de sus trabajos de ruptura e influencia en el liderazgo. Incluyendo el liderazgo internacional best-seller de Muhammad, explora la naturaleza de la motivación, estrategia y las habilidades necesarias para convertirse en un líder.

title: Leading Through Conflict: How Successful Leaders Transform Differences into Opportunities
description: As our world grows smaller, opportunities for conflict multiply. Ethnic, religious, political, and personal differences drive people apart—with potentially disastrous consequences—and it's the task of perceptive leaders to bring them together again World-renowned mediation expert Mark Gerzon argues that leaders have failed to rise to this challenge. Our organisations, schools, and governments remain filled with divisive dictators and everyday managers, instead of what he calls mediators—leaders who transform conflict so that everyone can move forward together. Through absorbing examples drawn from decades of work with organisational, political, and global conflicts of all kinds, Leading Through Conflict provides a powerful new framework for the leader as mediator, and outlines eight specific tools these leaders use to transform seemingly intractable differences into progress on deep-seated problems. Both practical and passionate, this book makes the tools of cross-border leaders accessible to anyone who wants to help create healthier companies, communities, and countries.
translatedDescription: A medida que nuestro mundo crece más pequeño, las oportunidades de conflicto se multiplican. Las diferencias étnicas, religiosas, políticas y personales alejan a la gente —con consecuencias potencialmente desastrosas— y es la tarea de los líderes perceptivos reunirlos de nuevo el renombrado experto en mediación mundial Mark Gerzon argumenta que los líderes no han podido enfrentar este desafío. Nuestras organizaciones, escuelas y gobiernos siguen llenos de dictadores divisivos y gestores cotidianos, en lugar de lo que él llama mediadores, líderes que transforman el conflicto para que todos puedan avanzar juntos. A través de la asimilación de ejemplos de décadas de trabajo con conflictos organizacionales, políticos y globales de todo tipo, Leading Through Conflict proporciona un nuevo marco poderoso para el líder como mediador, y describe ocho herramientas específicas que estos líderes utilizan para transformar diferencias aparentemente intrínsecas en progreso en problemas de fondo. Tanto práctico como apasionado, este libro hace accesibles las herramientas de los líderes transfronterizos a cualquiera que quiera ayudar a crear empresas, comunidades y países más saludables.

title: Nine Practices of 21st Century Leadership
description: Most leadership books focus on traditional leadership, which is based on managerial practices and command-and-control assumptions. Traditional leadership methods produce short-term gains but often at the cost of employee disengagement, team isolation, and distrust. Twenty-first century leadership methods produce short-term gains while inspiring cre
translatedDescription: La mayoría de los libros de liderazgo se centran en el liderazgo tradicional, que se basa en prácticas de gestión y hipótesis de mando y control. Los métodos tradicionales de liderazgo producen ganancias a corto plazo, pero a menudo a costa de la separación de los empleados, el aislamiento del equipo y la desconfianza. Los métodos de liderazgo del siglo XXI producen ganancias a corto plazo mientras inspiran cre

title: Leadership in Action: A Retention Strategy for the Ages
description: Knowing what Baby Boomers and, especially, Gen-Xers need and want in the workplace can provide an advantage in the battle for talent.
translatedDescription: Saber qué Baby Boomers y, especialmente, Gen-Xers necesitan y quieren en el lugar de trabajo puede proporcionar una ventaja en la batalla por el talento.

title: Leadership in Action: Morale Victories: How Leaders Can Build Positive Energy
description: It's not difficult to recognize an organization or team that has strong morale, pride, and spirit as opposed to one that does not. In the former, productivity and creativity are high and relationships are strong; in the latter, negativism, dissatisfaction, and friction reign. Here's a look at some steps leaders can take to enhance the characteristics that make for a prolific, efficient, cooperative, and loyal team.
translatedDescription: No es difícil reconocer una organización o equipo que tenga una fuerte moral, orgullo y espíritu en contra de uno que no lo hace. En el primero, la productividad y la creatividad son altas y las relaciones son fuertes; en este último reinan la negatividad, la insatisfacción y la fricción. He aquí un vistazo a algunos pasos que los líderes pueden tomar para mejorar las características que hacen para un equipo prolífico, eficiente, cooperativo y leal.

title: Leadership in Action: Getting Culture - Imbuing Your Organization with Coaching Behavior
description: Organizations are finding that creating a coaching culture, in which everyone thinks in terms of developing and improving the performance of others as an aspect of doing his or her own job, generates synergy.
translatedDescription: Las organizaciones están encontrando que crear una cultura de coaching, en la que todos piensan en desarrollar y mejorar el rendimiento de los demás como un aspecto de hacer su propio trabajo, genera sinergia.

title: What Managers Can Gain From Anonymous Chats
description: While anonymous feedback in teams can sometimes be less than constructive, when used the right way, digital chat tools that provide anonymity can help managers gauge employee morale and drive change.
translatedDescription: Mientras que la retroalimentación anónima en los equipos puede ser a veces menos que constructiva, cuando se utiliza de la manera correcta, las herramientas de chat digital que proporcionan anonimato pueden ayudar a los administradores a medir la moral del empleado y impulsar el cambio.

title: The Truth About Winning at Work (Collection), 2/e
description:
A brand new collection of management and leadership skills for improving business performance

4 authoritative books deliver world-class skills for leading change and improving performance throughout your team and organization!

You’re facing greater challenges than ever before – both outside your organization, and inside it. To win, you need today’s best skills for improving performance and driving change. Now, this 4-book collection presents hundreds of those skills simply, clearly, and quickly, to support action. In The Truth About Managing People, Third Edition bestselling author Stephen Robbins shares 61 proven principles and solutions for make-or-break, day-to-day management problems. Overcome the true obstacles to teamwork… avoid both over- and under-communication… improve hiring and employee evaluations… manage a culturally/generationally diverse or virtual workforces… combine stronger ethics and greater effectiveness… and much more. Next, in The Truth About Getting the Best From People, Second Edition, Martha Finney shares 60+ proven principles for gaining unprecedented employee engagement. This new edition features 15 new truths for managing virtual teams, overcoming your unconscious biases, managing multiple generations, identifying/cultivating individual high performers, and more. Next, persuade others in any environment with The Truth About Confident Presenting, by James O’Rourke. O’Rourke reveals 51 proven, concise, easy-to-use presenting techniques that work: all you need to know to prepare effectively (not obsessively), manage anxiety, connect with any audience, and succeed. Discover what makes people listen, and what instantly turns them off… how to muster evidence that’ll convince your specific audience… how to listen, establish a great first impression, and make nonverbal cues work for you… use PowerPoint and microphones well… handle hostile questions confidently; and much more. Finally, turn to William S. Kane’s The Truth About Thriving in Change for 49 proven ways to do what everyone wants, and few can deliver: lead successful change. Plan, drive, and sustain positive change that matters… transform organizations without destroying morale… objectively assess whether yours is really the best way… develop the change management skills you need most… know when to persuade, educate, or “use force”… create the right cultural framework you need to keep moving forward. These four eBooks aren’t “just someone’s opinion”: they offer definitive, evidence-based principles for improving performance throughout your entire leadership career!

From world-renowned workplace effectiveness expertsStephen P. Robbins, Martha I. Finney, James O’Rourke, and William S. Kane
translatedDescription:
Una nueva colección de habilidades de gestión y liderazgo para mejorar el rendimiento empresarial

4 libros autorizados ofrecen habilidades de clase mundial para liderar el cambio y mejorar el rendimiento en todo su equipo y organización!

Usted está enfrentando mayores desafíos que nunca antes – tanto fuera de su organización, como dentro de ella. Para ganar, necesitas las mejores habilidades de hoy para mejorar el rendimiento y el cambio de conducción. Ahora, esta colección de 4 libros presenta cientos de esas habilidades simplemente, claramente y rápidamente, para apoyar la acción. En la verdad sobre la gestión de personas, el autor de la tercera edición, Stephen Robbins, comparte 61 principios y soluciones probadas para problemas de gestión cotidianos. Superar los verdaderos obstáculos para el trabajo en equipo... evitar tanto la sobrecomunicación como la subcomunicación... mejorar las evaluaciones de contratación y empleados... gestionar una fuerza laboral cultural/generacionalmente diversa o virtual... combinar una ética más fuerte y una mayor eficacia... y mucho más. Siguiente, en la verdad sobre cómo obtener lo mejor de la gente, segunda edición, Martha Finney comparte 60 principios probados para obtener un compromiso de empleados sin precedentes. Esta nueva edición cuenta con 15 nuevas verdades para gestionar equipos virtuales, superar sus prejuicios inconscientes, gestionar múltiples generaciones, identificar/cultivar a los intérpretes altos individuales y más. A continuación, persuadir a otros en cualquier entorno con La Verdad Sobre la Presentación Confidencial, por James O’Rourke. O’Rourke revela 51 técnicas de presentación probadas, concisas y fáciles de usar que funcionan: todo lo que necesitas saber para prepararte eficazmente (no obsesivamente), gestionar la ansiedad, conectarte con cualquier público y tener éxito. Descubra lo que hace que la gente escuche, y lo que instantáneamente los apaga... cómo convencer a su público específico... cómo escuchar, establecer una gran primera impresión, y hacer que los cues no verbales funcionen para usted... utilizar PowerPoint y micrófonos bien... manejar preguntas hostiles con confianza; y mucho más. Finalmente, gire a William S. Kane La Verdad Acerca de Conducir en el Cambio para 49 formas comprobadas de hacer lo que todos quieren, y pocos pueden entregar: liderar el cambio exitoso. Planear, impulsar y sostener un cambio positivo que importa... transformar organizaciones sin destruir la moral... evaluar objetivamente si la tuya es realmente la mejor manera... desarrollar las habilidades de gestión del cambio que más necesitas... saber cuándo persuadir, educar o “fuerza de uso”... crear el marco cultural adecuado que necesitas para seguir adelante. Estos cuatro libros electrónicos no son “sólo la opinión de alguien”: ofrecen principios definitivos basados en evidencia para mejorar el rendimiento durante toda su carrera de liderazgo!

De expertos en eficacia en el trabajo de renombre mundialStephen P. Robbins, Martha I. Finney, James O’Rourke y William S. Kane

title: Make Leader Character Your Competitive Edge
description: The authors’ research into leader character demonstrates its effect on judgment and finds that fostering a culture where character is valued equally alongside competence can result in better decisions and outcomes. Furthermore, they find that, as with competence, character can be developed through education and practice.
translatedDescription: La investigación de los autores sobre el carácter de líder demuestra su efecto en el juicio y encuentra que fomentar una cultura en la que el carácter sea valorado por igual junto con la competencia puede dar lugar a mejores decisiones y resultados. Además, consideran que, al igual que con competencia, el carácter puede desarrollarse mediante la educación y la práctica.

title: Know What You Don’t Know: How Great Leaders Prevent Problems Before They Happen
description: Problems remain hidden in organizations for a number of reasons, including fear, organizational complexity, gatekeepers who insulate leaders from problems that are coming up, and finally, an overemphasis on formal analysis in place of intuition and observation. This book lays out the key skills and capabilities required to ensure that problems do not remain hidden in your organization. It explains how leaders can become effective problem finders, unearthing problems before they destroy an organization. The book explains how leaders can become an anthropologist, going out and observe how employees, customers, and suppliers actually behave. It then goes on to present how they can circumvent the gatekeepers, so they can go directly to the source to see and hear the raw data; hunt for patterns, including refining your individual and collective pattern recognition capability; "connect the dots" among issues that may initially seem unrelated, but in fact, have a great deal in common; give front-line employees training in a communication technique; encourage useful mistakes, including create a "Red Pencil Award"; and watch the game film, where leaders reflect systematically on their own organization's conduct and performance, as well as on the behavior and performance of competitors.
translatedDescription: Los problemas siguen ocultos en las organizaciones por varias razones, entre ellas el miedo, la complejidad organizativa, los porteros que aíslan a los líderes de los problemas que están surgiendo, y finalmente, una sobreemfasis sobre el análisis formal en lugar de intuición y observación. Este libro establece las habilidades y capacidades clave necesarias para asegurar que los problemas no permanezcan ocultos en su organización. Explica cómo los líderes pueden convertirse en buscadores de problemas eficaces, desenterrar problemas antes de destruir una organización.
